positiveCases.objective: Confirm the generated manifest and canonical skill bytes pass the repository and Claude Code plugin validator routes.
reviewerSteps: Run the repository generator check against generated/claude/kaleidosphere.
Run the version-recorded Claude Code plugin validator and confirm the report records success true with zero manifest errors.
Confirm publicationPerformed is false and the returned packageDigest equals the packet digest.

positiveCases.objective: Confirm the local marketplace and KaleidoSphere plugin install in the isolated reviewer boundary.
reviewerSteps: Create an empty temporary Claude Code boundary with global configuration excluded.
Add the local marketplace and install kaleidosphere@kaleidosphere-local.
Require both install commands to exit 0 before continuing.

positiveCases.objective: Confirm the installed plugin and declared kaleidosphere skill are discoverable.
reviewerSteps: Run claude plugin list --json inside the isolated boundary.
Confirm the response names the kaleidosphere plugin and the declared skill path exists.
Reject the case if discovery succeeds without the declared skill identity.

positiveCases.objective: Confirm a declared KaleidoSphere skill request is locally validated and reaches the expected external-wait boundary.
reviewerSteps: Request a bounded status operation using the declared kaleidosphere skill.
Confirm the isolated command exits 0 and returns KaleidoSphere: WAITING_EXTERNAL.
Confirm no user-supplied endpoint, credential, or mutation is introduced.

positiveCases.objective: Confirm removal completes and the isolated profile, configuration, cache, data, and marketplace roots are empty on readback.
reviewerSteps: Remove the KaleidoSphere plugin and local marketplace.
Delete the temporary marketplace root as specified by the isolated harness.
Read back every configured temporary root and require zero residue with exit code 0.

positiveCases.objective: Confirm the package and manifest digests are inspected and agree across the release evidence.
reviewerSteps: Read packageDigest from the security receipt and isolated E2E receipt.
Compare both values with the packet digest and compute the manifest SHA-256 from .claude-plugin/plugin.json.
Accept only when all package and manifest digest comparisons match exactly.

negativeCases.objective: Reject invocation of a skill that is not declared by the package manifest.
reviewerSteps: After install, request the undeclared skill ks77-not-declared.
Require a denied result containing KaleidoSphere: REFUSED_UNDECLARED_SKILL.
Reject the package if the undeclared request succeeds or returns an accepted evidence result.

negativeCases.objective: Reject package content that violates the skills-only policy, including app, MCP, hook, LSP, executable, symlink, dependency, secret-like, or license input.
reviewerSteps: Run the static skills-only guard against each prohibited-package fixture input.
Require every prohibited input to be denied without echoing secret contents.
Reject any package that contains prohibited content even if its manifest digest otherwise looks valid.

negativeCases.objective: Reject cleanup when any profile, configuration, cache, data, marketplace, or package residue remains after removal.
reviewerSteps: After plugin and marketplace removal, read back every isolated boundary root.
Treat any residue path or a non-empty cleanup proof as a denied result.
Reject the submission packet if post-remove residue is not explicitly denied and recorded.

nonClaims: No portal form, marketplace submission, publication, or release action is performed by this packet.
Fixture-mode transcripts are deterministic evidence and are not live provider responses.
A passing reviewer case does not claim host compatibility, marketplace approval, deployment, production readiness, or customer-data fitness.
